officialSources.observation: Official AkwaGIS public search page says it searches the Akwa Ibom land registry, validates a record for free by Land PIN or Plan/COD number, and displays a parcel polygon only after a matched paid search; owner/contact and underlying survey documents are not publicly exposed.
Official AkwaGIS portal describes the state-wide digital land administration system and aerial-mapping/geospatial-data service.
Akwa Ibom State Government online-services page identifies AkwaGIS as the state GIS for capturing all lands digitally for management.
Federal Office of the Surveyor-General source gives general Nigerian cadastral/survey context only; it is not an Oron-specific public parcel service.

requests.outcome: Current Next.js viewer page read. It exposes a public validation/payment workflow, not a map-service URL or downloadable parcel layer.

Current JavaScript/configuration inspected. API base is /api/v1; search validation route is POST /api/v1/search/validate; result and parcel routes require a transaction/search context. No public geometry endpoint, schema, or CRS was exposed.
Public service catalog returned; it describes land-service workflows and did not return parcel features or a geometry layer.
